desc:
You are given a string digits made of the characters 0-9. Choose some of these digits (each position at most once, so a digit can be used only as many times as it occurs), arrange them in any order and form a number that is a palindrome. The number must not have leading zeros, except that the number 0 itself is allowed.

Return the largest such number as a string. At least one digit must be used.

For example, "444947137" gives "7449447". "00009" gives "9", because "00900" would have leading zeros. "000" gives "0". "0011" gives "1001".
constraints: The result has no leading zero unless it is exactly "0"
hints: A bigger number is one with more digits, and among equal lengths, one with larger leading digits. So first maximize the length, then the digits from the front.

Pairs of equal digits go symmetrically around the center. Take as many pairs as you can; the largest digits go to the outside. A leftover single digit can sit in the middle: pick the largest one available.
Careful with zeros: a pair of zeros cannot be the outermost pair. If there is no pair of non-zero digits at all, the best you can do is a single digit, namely the largest digit present.
editorial: Count the occurrences of every digit. A palindrome consists of mirrored pairs plus at most one middle digit, so the longest palindrome uses count // 2 pairs of every digit. Build the left half from the pairs, putting digits 9, 8, ..., 1 first, in that order; this makes the left half as large as possible, and the right half is its mirror image.

Zero pairs are special: they can only go strictly inside, so they are appended after all non-zero pairs (the smallest digit, hence at the end of the left half), and only if the left half is not empty already. If no non-zero digit appears at least twice, the left half is empty and the best answer is the single largest digit (which may be 0).

For the middle, use the largest digit whose count is odd (the leftover after pairing), including 0 if its count is odd. If every count is even, there is no middle. Counting is O(n), building the answer is O(n), and the space is O(n) for the output.
